column1: Under the theme of relative motion, here are some unique and realistic conditions that can be used or expanded in everyday physical scenarios: movement of objects on an inclined plane; introducing friction and changing its magnitude or direction; adding obstacles in the path of motion; introducing elastic collisions between multiple objects; introducing variable speed motion, such as acceleration or deceleration; incorporating the effects of inertia in motion; considering changes in the frame of reference of motion, such as from a stationary frame to a moving frame; adding oscillatory or periodic motion in movement; introducing the impact of surfaces made of different materials on motion; introducing conditions for steering or changing the trajectory in motion. These conditions can enhance the complexity or diversity of scenarios related to relative motion on a visible macroscopic scale.
